What Is IGF-1 LR3?

IGF-1 LR3 (Insulin-Like Growth Factor-1 Long R3) is a modified form of insulin-like growth factor-1 designed with a longer duration of activity than naturally occurring IGF-1.

Unlike peptides that stimulate the release of growth hormone, IGF-1 LR3 is itself a growth factor analogue and is commonly researched for its interaction with cellular growth and repair pathways.

Researchers commonly investigate IGF-1 LR3 in relation to:

  • Cellular growth signalling
  • Recovery
  • Exercise physiology
  • Body composition
  • Muscle biology
  • Performance-focused research
